title: Grinding and Polishing Workers, Hand
description: Grind, sand, or polish, using hand tools or hand-held power tools, a variety of metal, wood, stone, clay, plastic, or glass objects. Includes chippers, buffers, and finishers.

tasks.text: Verify quality of finished workpieces by inspecting them, comparing them to templates, measuring their dimensions, or testing them in working machinery.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vision AI assists but physical comparison is human

dwas.name: Compare physical characteristics of materials or products to specifications or standards.
Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Grind, sand, clean, or polish objects or parts to correct defects or to prepare surfaces for further finishing, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of physical workpieces

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.
Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.
Smooth metal surfaces or edges.

tasks.text: Measure and mark equipment, objects, or parts to ensure grinding and polishing standards are met.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Trim, scrape, or deburr objects or parts, using chisels, scrapers, and other hand tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Mark defects, such as knotholes, cracks, and splits, for repair.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Study blueprints or layouts to determine how to lay out workpieces or saw out templates.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprints need spatial reading, human verifies sequence

dwas.name: Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Move controls to adjust, start, or stop equipment during grinding and polishing processes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Load and adjust workpieces onto equipment or work tables, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Repair and maintain equipment, objects, or parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on repair of production machinery

dwas.name: Repair production equipment or tools.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Select files or other abrasives, according to materials, sizes and shapes of workpieces, amount of stock to be removed, finishes specified, and steps in finishing processes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: File grooved, contoured, and irregular surfaces of metal objects, such as metalworking dies and machine parts, to conform to templates, other parts, layouts, or blueprint specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reshaping metal requires hands-on machining

dwas.name: Reshape metal workpieces to established specifications.

tasks.text: Sharpen abrasive grinding tools, using machines and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual sharpening of cutting tools

dwas.name: Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Transfer equipment, objects, or parts to specified work areas, using moving devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.

tasks.text: Remove completed workpieces from equipment or work tables, using hand tools, and place workpieces in containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Record product and processing data on specified forms.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Apply solutions and chemicals to equipment, objects, or parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying solutions to equipment is manual

dwas.name: Apply solutions to production equipment.

tasks.text: Clean brass particles from files by drawing file cards through file grooves.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
